ConnectorGuards.description: Limits set on the connector itself, in every environment.

row_ceiling.description: The most rows one lookup through this connector may return. A location's max_rows above it is refused by owl check and at save, and a lookup never returns more.
row_ceiling.title: Row Ceiling

ConnectorGuards.title: ConnectorGuards

RestBinding.description: Where a REST connector points in one environment.

anyOf.description: Where a credential lives: keyring:<service>/<username>, env:<VARIABLE> or vault://<path>. Never the credential itself.

secret.description: The API token, if one is needed. Written as a reference, never the value: keyring:<service>/<username> reads the system keychain entry for that service and username (add it with `keyring set <service> <username>`); env:<VARIABLE> reads an environment variable; vault://<path> is accepted but not supported yet.
secret.title: Secret

RestBinding.title: RestBinding

RestConnector.description: A read-only client for one REST API. Only GET is ever sent.

environments.description: One binding per environment; a missing one means Not configured there.
environments.title: Environments

RestConnector.title: RestConnector

SqlBinding.description: Where a SQL connector points in one environment.

database.description: Database name (SQL Server, MariaDB) or service name (Oracle).
database.title: Database

schema.description: Oracle only: the schema unqualified table names resolve in (CURRENT_SCHEMA). SQL Server and MariaDB use the database instead.
schema.title: Schema

time_zone.description: Oracle only: the time zone of each session, as an offset from -12:00 to +14:00, such as +04:00. It is what CURRENT_DATE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP and LOCALTIMESTAMP return in, and how a TIMESTAMP is compared with a TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE. Omitted: the database's own (DBTIMEZONE), never the time zone of the machine running ProbeOwl.
time_zone.title: Time Zone

secret.description: The login's password. Written as a reference, never the value: keyring:<service>/<username> reads the system keychain entry for that service and username (add it with `keyring set <service> <username>`); env:<VARIABLE> reads an environment variable; vault://<path> is accepted but not supported yet.
secret.title: Secret

replica.description: This binding points at a read replica. Production bindings must.
replica.title: Replica

max_replica_lag.description: Replica bindings: when the replica's measured lag is longer, the circuit breaker pauses this connector and runs that need it are skipped.
max_replica_lag.title: Max Replica Lag

allowed_databases.description: SQL Server and MariaDB: other databases on the same server that probes may name (otherdb.dbo.table, otherdb.table). This binding's own database is always allowed.
allowed_databases.title: Allowed Databases

encrypt.description: MariaDB and Oracle: encrypt the connection with TLS (Oracle connects over tcps). Set false only for a server that cannot offer TLS, such as a local test container. SQL Server connections are always encrypted.
encrypt.title: Encrypt

encrypt_reason.description: Why this binding is not encrypted. Required by `owl check` when a Production binding sets encrypt: false.
encrypt_reason.title: Encrypt Reason

trust_server_certificate.description: Accept any server certificate, skipping the check that it is signed by a trusted authority and names the host, as on local test containers. Never needed for a properly configured server.
trust_server_certificate.title: Trust Server Certificate

trust_server_certificate_reason.description: Why this binding trusts any server certificate. Required by `owl check` when a Production binding sets trust_server_certificate.
trust_server_certificate_reason.title: Trust Server Certificate Reason

SqlBinding.title: SqlBinding

SqlConnector.description: A read-only client for one SQL Server, Oracle or MariaDB database.

environments.description: One binding per environment; a missing one means Not configured there.
environments.title: Environments

SqlConnector.title: SqlConnector
